Made from premium, US grown hemp, our powder is designed to be easily dissolved in any food or beverage of your choice- hot or cold. With precise dosing and fast-acting effects, our dissolvable CBD powder allows you to tailor your CBD intake to your individual needs.

It's a perfect solution for those seeking relief from a variety of concerns, such as stress, lack of focus, poor sleep, or quicker muscle recovery.

How Much CBD Should I Take?

When starting a CBD regimen, we recommend beginning with 10-20mg of CBD per day for the first week to ensure it is well tolerated.

You can then gradually increase your daily dose by increments of 5mg until you find your optimal dose, depending on what feels best for you.

See Our Dosage Guide

settings.title: Why should I choose CBD powder?
settings.text: Adding CBD powder to your food or drink is a tasty and convenient way of getting your daily dose, whilst also enjoying a delicious meal or treat. Or you can sprinkle sachets straight into your mouth to take CBD on the go.

settings.title: How much CBD powder should I use?
settings.text: Be mindful of how much CBD you add to your food or drink. Always read the label to understand how much CBD is in each serving, then measure it carefully to ensure you’re using the correct amount. Sachets will already have a precisely measured dose in them.

settings.title: Does CBD Make You High?
settings.text:
No - CBD will not make you high. This is because CBD is a completely different compound to that of THC (the intoxicating constituent of the cannabis plant). 

Hemp-derived CBD products are non-intoxicating and have zero psychoactive properties. High-quality CBD products can be used safely in your daily routine to support health and promote wellbeing.

settings.title: Is CBD Legal?
settings.text:
Yes, CBD products are legal but they must meet regulatory standards. The World Health Organization describes CBD as “generally well tolerated” and as having “a good safety profile”. 

Therefore it is important to only use high-quality CBD products from trusted retailers.
